verdict.rationale: Ledgy's docs confirm a programmatic API (OAuth service accounts, a companyCaptable operation) that lets an authenticated client pull cap table data, satisfying the 'pull cap table programmatically' half of the story. However, there is no evidence of any data-room feature, document ingestion/reconciliation capability, or agent-oriented tooling (no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt, probes return 404) to support cross-referencing cap table data against a data room before financing. Missing for 10: data room integration/API, reconciliation logic or workflow, and any agent-specific tooling/spec discoverability.
